professionalSummary.headline: Solution architect and Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production systems.
professionalSummary.summary: Backend-focused engineer working across networking infrastructure, multi-tenant SaaS, fintech payments, healthtech, and AI/LLM platforms. Sole technical architect on systems spanning 45+ globally distributed VPN servers across 20+ regions serving 2M+ mobile users, and on multi-tenant platforms with isolated per-tenant data architecture serving hospitality, pharmacy, and retail operators in production. Owns the full stack end to end: system design, API and database architecture, cloud and server provisioning, observability, and infrastructure automation. As Founder and CTO of CoreByte Studio, has taken 8+ SaaS and infrastructure products from architecture through launch and managed operations.
specializations: Multi-tenant SaaS with isolated per-tenant data models

responsibilities: Architected secure backend APIs and a Super Admin Dashboard for eEagle VPN, owning server allocation, authentication, and fleet-wide lifecycle management across 45+ servers in 20+ regions.
Built infrastructure-as-code automation for VPN and server provisioning using WireGuard, Node.js, and Bash.
Built a script.sh remote provisioning pipeline that replaced manual setup with repeatable scripted workflows.
Stood up Grafana and Prometheus observability with Kafka, Docker, Node, and Redis exporters and alerting rules.
Own security hardening and performance across the production fleet.
Shipped the eEagle VPN Chrome Extension for browser-level VPN access.
Architected RESTful APIs and backend systems for Hoheal, a multi-vendor hotel management SaaS with service-request workflows and real-time staff-guest chat.
Designed backend architecture for PIKUP POS, including QR table ordering, real-time POS synchronization, and Next.js dashboards.
Designed Ajar, a multi-vendor rental platform with Stripe payments and document-verification-backed registration.
Designed the backend and MAIB payment integration for Bite.md, a multi-vendor pharma, grocery, and restaurant marketplace.
Directed cross-functional React.js and Flutter delivery, shipping four production SaaS platforms in 12 months.
Engineered backend APIs powering Flutter apps, marketplaces, automation tools, e-commerce, and B2B systems.
Led the architecture of a real-time Socket.io messaging platform with file transfers, forwarding, and reactions.
Optimized MySQL and MongoDB schemas for query performance and data integrity.
Architected subscription and billing payment workflows.
Owned AWS deployment and GitHub Actions CI/CD, cutting deployment time by 40%.
Engineered backend APIs for Flutter apps, marketing websites, and admin dashboards.
Designed and launched a multi-vendor service marketplace on AWS.
Built a real-time chat system for vendor-user interactions.
Integrated Stripe payment infrastructure, reducing payment errors.
